summary: Explore all candidate solutions via recursive choose/explore/un-choose, pruning branches that can't lead to a valid answer.
recognize_when: need to enumerate valid configurations under constraints (N-Queens, Sudoku)
problem says 'find all' or 'return all possible'
decision tree with a choice at each step that can be undone
brute force with pruning is acceptable given small input size

complexity.notes: b = branching factor, d = max depth; recursion stack plus path storage, pruning reduces the effective branching factor

gotchas: forgetting to copy path (path[:]) when appending to results, so all results alias the same mutated list
not undoing state changes (visited sets, used flags) after the recursive call returns
missing pruning/validity checks leads to exponential blowup or infinite recursion on cyclic choices
